source_description: QA bug reward [trivial] to zeta-da-xiaojie: awakening.py Model 欄位顯示與實際不符 — registry seed 寫死 'claude-sonnet' 但本小姐實際跑的是 Opus 4.7 1M (Tim Discord 截圖確認). resolve_bank_account combo lookup 永遠 fallback (sonnet 那筆 entry 從未命中). 修法: model 該為 free-form display field, agent_model_combos 改成 (agent → bank_account) lookup, 不參與 model 比對. (ref: AwakeningModelDisplayMismatch)
